mapper.select: SELECT id, workspace_id AS workspaceId, subject_type AS subjectType, subject_id AS subjectId, item_id AS itemId, kind, tool_name AS toolName, args_json AS argsJson, card_json AS cardJson, policy, assignee_json AS assigneeJson, status, decided_by AS decidedBy, decided_at AS decidedAt, answer_json AS answerJson, expires_at AS expiresAt, create_at AS createAt, update_at AS updateAt, create_by AS createBy, update_by AS updateBy FROM runtime_approval WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, workspace_id AS workspaceId, subject_type AS subjectType, subject_id AS subjectId, item_id AS itemId, kind, tool_name AS toolName, args_json AS argsJson, card_json AS cardJson, policy, assignee_json AS assigneeJson, status, decided_by AS decidedBy, decided_at AS decidedAt, answer_json AS answerJson, expires_at AS expiresAt, create_at AS createAt, update_at AS updateAt, create_by AS createBy, update_by AS updateBy FROM runtime_approval WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO runtime_approval ( id, workspace_id, subject_type, subject_id, item_id, kind, tool_name, args_json, card_json, policy, assignee_json, status, expires_at, request_id, subject, requested_by, title, risk, agent_id, create_at, update_at, create_by, update_by ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{workspaceId}, #{subjectType}, #{subjectId}, #{itemId}, #{kind}, #{toolName}, #{argsJson}, #{cardJson}, #{policy}, #{assigneeJson}, #{status}, #{expiresAt}, #{requestId}, #{subject}, #{requestedBy}, #{title}, #{risk}, #{agentId}, now(), now(), COALESCE(#{createBy}, 'system'), COALESCE(#{updateBy}, 'system') )
mapper.update: UPDATE runtime_approval SET status = #{status}, decided_by = #{decidedBy}, decided_at = now(), answer_json = #{answerJson}, update_at = now(), update_by = COALESCE(#{updateBy}, 'system') WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING'
mapper.select: SELECT id, workspace_id AS workspaceId, subject_type AS subjectType, subject_id AS subjectId, item_id AS itemId, kind, tool_name AS toolName, args_json AS argsJson, card_json AS cardJson, policy, assignee_json AS assigneeJson, status, decided_by AS decidedBy, decided_at AS decidedAt, answer_json AS answerJson, expires_at AS expiresAt, create_at AS createAt, update_at AS updateAt, create_by AS createBy, update_by AS updateBy FROM runtime_approval WHERE subject_type = #{subjectType} AND subject_id = #{subjectId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM runtime_approval WHERE subject_type = #{subjectType} AND subject_id = #{subjectId} AND status = 'PENDING'

SELECT id, workspace_id AS workspaceId, subject_type AS subjectType, subject_id AS subjectId, item_id AS itemId, kind, tool_name AS toolName, args_json AS argsJson, card_json AS cardJson, policy, assignee_json AS assigneeJson, status, decided_by AS decidedBy, decided_at AS decidedAt, answer_json AS answerJson, expires_at AS expiresAt, request_id AS requestId, subject, create_at AS createAt, update_at AS updateAt, create_by AS createBy, update_by AS updateBy FROM runtime_approval WHERE item_id = #{itemId} ORDER BY create_at DESC LIMIT 1

UPDATE runtime_approval SET status = 'EXPIRED', decided_by = COALESCE(#{decidedBy}, 'system'), decided_at = now(), update_at = now(), update_by = 'system' WHERE status = 'PENDING' AND expires_at < #{now} RETURNING id
mapper.update: UPDATE runtime_approval SET status = 'EXPIRED', decided_by = #{decidedBy}, decided_at = now(), update_at = now(), update_by = 'system' WHERE subject_type = #{subjectType} AND subject_id = #{subjectId} AND status = 'PENDING'
mapper.select: SELECT t.id, t.thread_id AS threadId FROM runtime_turn t WHERE t.status = 'WAITING_APPROVAL' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM runtime_approval a WHERE a.subject_type = 'turn' AND a.subject_id = t.id AND a.status = 'PENDING') LIMIT 50
